items.source: Auto-configuration for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.
items.translation: Model 上下文协议（MCP）服务器的自动配置。

items.source:
This class defines a condition met when the MCP server is enabled and the STDIO
Transport is disabled.
items.translation: 该类定义了当 MCP 服务器已启用且 STDIO 传输被禁用时满足的条件。
